text_block_list.text:
After training with Sirius Symboli, we 
were watching TV in the break room when—

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
I heard that an overseas expedition in an 
unfamiliar environment wears you down 
mentally, not to mention physically.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There were moments when I even began 
to doubt the skills I cultivated in Japan, 
and my confidence in running.

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
During all that time, what was it that 
supported you emotionally?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... In the end, I believe it was 
the presence of my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Her meticulous thoughtfulness, her 
encouraging words. And above all, the fact 
that "she was always by my side."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I had an absolute ally by my side—that 
truth always gave me courage.

Watching Speed Symboli's interview 
reminded me of Sirius Symboli, whom I 
train. That's because she has her sights 
set on an overseas campaign too.

It goes without saying that Sirius Symboli 
is an Umamusume blessed with exceptional 
physical and mental fortitude, but—

There's no way to know how things will 
turn out in an unfamiliar place overseas 
unless we actually go...
choice_data_list:
(Then I'll make sure to stay by her side 
and support her!)

(Then I'll make sure to stay by her side 
and support her!)

text_block_list.text: A few hours later—

While taking a walk outside for a 
breather, an unexpected sight caught my 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What's up, pup? What're you doing out 
here? Isn't it past your bedtime?
choice_data_list: What brings you here, of all people?

text_block_list.text:
"It is quite late, and above all, today's 
training should already be over."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No ifs, ands, or buts about it. There's 
only one reason."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can't see the real world just by 
running on pristine turf. —That's all 
there is to it.

She seems to be talking about overseas 
racetracks. Indeed, there are various 
differences compared to Japan, such as 
greater elevation changes and deeper turf.

"So you foresaw that, and are preparing 
for it now."

She always exceeds expectations. She is 
constantly thinking far ahead into the 
future.
choice_data_list:
I want to be by your side, supporting all 
your efforts.

I want to support your efforts by your 
side.

text_block_list.text:
She will surely spread her wings and take 
on the world. Difficult situations will 
undoubtedly arise. When that happens, 
without fail—
choice_data_list:
No matter where in the world you are, I'll 
be on your side!

Wherever you are in the world, I'll always 
be on your side!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What's gotten you so fired up out of 
nowhere? Did you eat something weird?

I told her that watching Speed Symboli's 
interview had reaffirmed my determination.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. So easily influenced.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Then again, you're right—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking of heading to Italy 
tomorrow to scout the opposition. If 
you're coming, get ready right now."

Her statement came out of nowhere, but I 
just vowed to stand by her side and 
support her...!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll go pack my things!
What do I do, I don't speak Italian...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's a few things I wanna 
bring. Shoes, supplements, and then—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Dumbbells, barbells... ...You can get 
those ready for me, right? Like a good 
kid?

If I could prepare one, I would, but could 
I actually carry a barbell...?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so? What a shame.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'm leaving you behind. Have a nice 
little snooze and wait here."

What should I do? I just swore to support 
her by her side, and yetâ!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Of course it was a joke.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a great reaction. I 
enjoyed it thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna be together that much, keep 
working hard, puppy?
